!
hostname rt-v11
!
ipv6 unicast-routing
!
ipv6 dhcp pool dhcpv6-sample-lan
 dns-server 2001:db8::53
 import dns-server
!
interface Loopback0
 ip address 198.51.100.254 255.255.255.255
 ipv6 address 2001:db8::1/128
 ipv6 ospf 1 area 0
!
interface GigabitEthernet0/0
 description IPoE sample
 no ip address
 ipv6 address fe80::11 link-local
 ipv6 address autoconfig default
 ipv6 enable
 ipv6 dhcp client pd pd-sample
 ipv6 traffic-filter v6-sample-in in
!
interface GigabitEthernet0/1
 description LAN sample
 ip address 192.0.2.1 255.255.255.0
 ipv6 address pd-sample ::1/64
 ipv6 nd other-config-flag
 ipv6 nd ra dns server 2001:db8::53 1800
 ipv6 dhcp server dhcpv6-sample-lan
 ipv6 ospf 1 area 0
!
interface Tunnel1
 description DS-Lite sample
 ip unnumbered GigabitEthernet0/1
 tunnel source GigabitEthernet0/0
 tunnel mode ipv6
 tunnel destination aftr.example.jp
!
ip route 0.0.0.0 0.0.0.0 Tunnel1
!
ipv6 route 2001:db8:100::/48 GigabitEthernet0/0 fe80::2 name to-sample
!
ipv6 router ospf 1
 router-id 198.51.100.254
 passive-interface GigabitEthernet0/1
 redistribute static
!
ipv6 prefix-list pl6-sample seq 5 permit 2001:db8::/32 le 64
!
ipv6 access-list v6-sample-in
 permit icmp any any
 permit udp any eq 547 any eq 546
 permit tcp any any established
 deny ipv6 any any
!
end
